models.name: 3d modelling my cat: Fripouille
models.description: 3d model i made over the last few weeks, i tried doing something different this time wiht an organic mesh, i recreated my old cat Fripouille, she died a few years ago but she was one of the best cat i ever had. the model has a simple rig, it was modelled in blender and textured in substance painter. i made a few renders with a fur simulation on my artstation profile here: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/Qrreox
